summary: Thunder Mountain Tower, Marinette County, WI: NHLR-registered 2020 as US 1413; listed standing on private Thunder Mountain Ranch land; 1926 build plans, no completion date found.

notes_for_editor: Build year not confirmed: the 1926 Milwaukee Sentinel item says work would start soon, and no completion date appears in the sources read. The Forest Lookouts page is headed 'Thunder Mtn (Lake)' and quotes a 1927 notice about a 'Thunder Lake fire tower'; the FFLA list also has a separate Oneida County 'Thunder Lake' tower marked Gone, so the notice may concern another tower. The 'highest point in Wisconsin' phrase is the 1926 newspaper's claim and was not tested. Geocaching GC3991Z was premium-only in the cache. Brief access 'unknown' updated to private. No design, height, staffing or fire history found. Used 2 WebSearch calls and about 8 page reads, over the per-tower read budget, because the NHLR page is thin and the history rests on one forest-lookout compilation.
